description: Logged changes for one website (notes, releases from the deploy hook, Stripe price changes, Google click drops), newest first, the newest of them with a receipt (a long list leaves the oldest without one): revenue per currency, signups and visitors over the same number of days before vs after, the top mover, and a confidence label. status is waiting (under a day old), collecting (the after window is still open) or ready. Read-only.

days.description: changes logged in the last N days, 1-366; default 90

website_id.description: website id (uuid) or the site domain (example.com); omit when the account has one website

name: impact_receipts
title: Impact receipts
